finding.expected: Restrict proposal evidence collection to pairwise results whose two endpoints are both members of the selected canonical group. Normal cross-group results between valid graph observations must be ignored for this proposal, while missing or duplicate induced member pairs and truly malformed endpoints not belonging to graph.observations must still fail closed. Add a focused regression with one approvable POSITIVE_CONNECTED group plus at least one observation in another provisional group and prove proposal creation succeeds with exactly the selected group's induced N*(N-1)/2 evidence only.
finding.issue: A valid canonical TASK-111 POSITIVE_CONNECTED group cannot be proposed when its TASK-109 graph contains any observation in another provisional group. TASK-109 preserves pairwise results for every unordered observation pair, so cross-group results with one endpoint inside the selected group and one endpoint in another valid graph group are normal graph evidence. The current induced-result scan raises `induced pair evidence references a non-member endpoint` whenever exactly one endpoint is outside the selected group, which incorrectly treats normal cross-group pairwise results as malformed induced evidence. As a result, create_family_merge_proposal works only when the selected group contains all graph observations, violating AC1 for otherwise valid canonical graph/group inputs.
